en.shortDescription: Visual builder for AI agents and LLM workflows
en.longDescription:
Flowise is a drag-and-drop tool for building AI agents, chatbots, and LLM workflows.

Data persists under /root/.flowise. Register your admin account on first launch. Set APP_URL via SERVICE_URL_FLOWISE when behind a reverse proxy.

de.shortDescription: Visueller Builder für KI-Agenten und LLM-Workflows
de.longDescription:
Flowise ist ein Drag-and-Drop-Tool zum Erstellen von KI-Agenten, Chatbots und LLM-Workflows.

Daten bleiben unter /root/.flowise erhalten. Registriere dein Admin-Konto beim ersten Start. Setze APP_URL über SERVICE_URL_FLOWISE, wenn ein Reverse-Proxy verwendet wird.

fr.shortDescription: Constructeur visuel d'agents IA et de workflows LLM
fr.longDescription:
Flowise est un outil glisser-déposer pour créer des agents IA, des chatbots et des workflows LLM.

Les données persistent sous /root/.flowise. Créez votre compte administrateur au premier lancement. Définissez APP_URL via SERVICE_URL_FLOWISE derrière un reverse proxy.

pt.shortDescription: Construtor visual de agentes de IA e workflows LLM
pt.longDescription:
Flowise é uma ferramenta de arrastar e soltar para construir agentes de IA, chatbots e workflows LLM.

Os dados persistem em /root/.flowise. Registre sua conta de administrador no primeiro acesso. Defina APP_URL via SERVICE_URL_FLOWISE atrás de um proxy reverso.
